Title: Remote Cockpit Foundation
User Story / Description: Set up auth, DB, event bus, gateway and bootstrap admin.

Title: OIDC login
User Story / Description: As a user I can log into the cockpit with SSO.

Title: Resource registry
User Story / Description: As an admin I can register internal RDP/VNC/SSH resources.

Title: Guacamole session launch
User Story / Description: As a user I can open a remote desktop in the browser.

Title: Mobile controls
User Story / Description: As a mobile user I can control remote GUI without native app.

Title: Terminal persistence
User Story / Description: As a developer I can reconnect to a terminal session without losing work.

Title: Demo share link
User Story / Description: As a user I can share read-only session with expiry.

Title: Audit log
User Story / Description: As a security officer I can inspect session events.

Title: Agentic Desktop Foundation
User Story / Description: Desktop app with local worker and model provider registry.

Title: Desktop worker health
User Story / Description: As a user I can see whether the local agent worker is online.

Title: Model profile config
User Story / Description: As a user I can add frontier API key or local endpoint.

Title: Approval timeline
User Story / Description: As a user I approve/deny tool calls from desktop/mobile.

Title: QR phone dispatch
User Story / Description: As a user I pair phone to desktop session via short-lived QR.

Title: Agentic Work Board
User Story / Description: Agent-native ticket board with run timeline and evidence packets.

Title: Create ticket
User Story / Description: As a user I can create a ticket with acceptance criteria.

Title: Attach agent run
User Story / Description: As a user I can start/watch an agent run from a ticket.

Title: Evidence packet
User Story / Description: As a reviewer I can inspect diff, logs and screenshots before accepting.

Title: Code Forge Integration
User Story / Description: Connect to Gitea/GitLab/GitHub Enterprise before native forge.
